about.title: An engineer who has also run a business
about.body1: I’m Faiz, based in Palembang. I build apps and systems from the first conversation to the day they are in use, from screens that are easy to understand and data that stays tidy to smart features like face recognition when they are genuinely needed.
about.body2: I currently work as an app developer at Loranet Technologies PLT, a technology company in Malaysia, while still running Berkala Digital, the agency I founded in 2025, where I lead the creative and IT teams. Running a business taught me something app builders often learn late, which is that an app is only finished when the people using it trust it.
